name: again
title: Again
description: Pick one small thing a day and keep it in your menu bar.
author: carlomakes

commands.name: today
commands.title: Pick Today's Thing
commands.description: Pick one thing for today, answer how it went, or make it smaller.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Show Today's Thing
commands.description: Keep today's one thing in the menu bar.

preferences.name: showTitle
preferences.label: Show today's thing in the menu bar
preferences.description: Turn off to show only the icon. The menu bar is the first place macOS hides things when it is full.

preferences.name: eveningNudge
preferences.label: Change the icon in the evening if today is still open
preferences.description: After 6 p.m. the circle gets three dots and the tooltip says it is still open. Same quiet gray, no sound, no notification.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
